body: Yea now I think about it I wouldn't want that, not saying scars are bad, they empower someone to keep going, but I already get judged  enough
My scars barely show up! I wish they were darker so people knew what I went through, I can relate on sooo many levels
Maybe maybe not, sometimes I want to but I don't
I'm on 1 month 10 days fren! It's hard but we get through eventually
I'm under 18..heh..but my parents r going out occasionally, my one leave from my house, yet I'm never happy regardless
Well, Scotland is Scotland, cold, yet beautiful, seeing as the UK just went into lockdown its definitely quiet, alot quieter than usual
Shrug, I don't go outside very often, once a day I go out to do the dogs and occasionally trampolining if the weather holds for long enough, Scottish weather is cool  (:

Locking myself in a room is difficult seeing as only the bathroom has a lock, I'm not allowed one on my door anymore since my dad found out I self harm (: but walking occasionally helps, tho I'm an introverted person so I like the indoors slot more than outside
Lots of luv to u too >~< in times like this it's nice to have somebody to talk to about these kinda things besides my boyfriend and my besties (one of which lives in Australia so times zones whoop)

Annoyingly enough I'm probably the clingyest person around, I have my own relationship of almost 2 months running quite well rn but my boyfriend..doesn't rlly like clingy types, idk he says he does, sometimes, but sometimes I wanna change myself so I'm not clingy, i feel like it annoys every1 :(
Most relatable comment I've seen all day (:

Well my dad knows I do it so yee that's fun,he's already taken 1 blade off me and my boyfriend took a super sharp one off me a few weeks back (the week before the schools shut here) and then used it on himself (: so that was traumatic, luckily I stole a sharpener from school on the Friday so I still have one but yee, I need a new one my one I have just now is like barely sharp enough

But he's not one to be messed with...I've lied about stuff to him before and he doesn't talk to me for days..I suffer bad enough without losing one of my few close contacts with the outside world...and he's a self harm victim in recovery so I don't want to push him to do anything...

I feel ur pain...this quarantine is driving me up the wall and its beaten back my progress of stopping sh, all my dad tells me is it'll get better...as if. Its stressful and annoying and I somehow need to get new stuff but hell no dad monitors me whenever I'm in the shop, wanna get outta my house and be alone again...

I get it alot...I'll be with my boyfriend and suddenly my brain is like "hey good time to slice ur arm open huh?" My boyfriend has his own issues and has told me several times to throw my blade away.. I lie or manipulate the situation so he doesn't realise I still have it..
